1.w: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out its seven pillars.

2.w: She has prepared her meat, she has mixed her wine; she also has arranged her table.

3.w: She has sent out her female servants; she calls out on the highest places of the city.

4.w: “Whoever is naive, let him turn in here.” To those who lack understanding, she has said,

5.w: “Come, eat some of my food, and drink some of the wine I have mixed.

6.w: Abandon your foolish ways so that you may live, and proceed in the way of understanding.”

7.w: Whoever corrects a mocker is asking for insult; whoever reproves a wicked person receives abuse.

8.w: Do not reprove a mocker, or he will hate you; reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

9.w: Give instruction to a wise person, and he will become wiser still; teach a righteous person, and he will add to his learning.

10.w: The beginning of wisdom is to fear the Lord, and acknowledging the Holy One is understanding.

11.w: For because of me your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.

12.w: If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage, but if you have mocked, you alone must bear it.

13.w: The woman called Folly is brash; she is naive and does not know anything.

14.w: And she has sat down at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,

15.w: calling out to those who are passing by her in the way, who go straight on their way.

16.w: “Whoever is naive, let him turn in here,” To those who lack understanding she has said,

17.w: “Stolen waters are sweet, and food obtained in secret is pleasant!”

18.w: But they do not realize that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of the grave.
